title: Motor imagery + spatial attention dataset from Forenzo & He 2023
description: EEG dataset from 25 healthy participants performing a cursor-control brain-computer interface task across five sessions. The study combined motor imagery, overt spatial attention, and simultaneous motor imagery with spatial attention (MIOSA), with online visual cursor feedback. Recordings used 64 channels at 1000 Hz, and this release provides left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery trials.
methods_description: 64-channel EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap and SynAmps 2/RT amplifier at 1000 Hz, referenced between Cz and CPz, with a 200 Hz lowpass and 60 Hz notch online. Each participant completed 5 sessions of 3 motor imagery runs with 5 trials each, controlling a cursor in continuous pursuit with online feedback. Control used alpha-band power from autoregressive spectral estimation with Laplacian spatial filtering and a linear classifier.
